metadata.article_title: Protection of action taken in good faith.

article.title: Protection of action taken in good faith.
article.content: No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Protection Officer for any damage caused or likely to be caused by anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act or any rule or order made thereunder.
article.html:
35Protection of action taken in good faith.

Section 35 · Chapter V · page 11 of the Act

No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Protection Officer for any damage caused or likely to be caused by anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act or any rule or order made thereunder.
